title: Elementalist Third Eye
wikitext:
{{Armor art infobox

|campaign=[[Prophecies]], [[Nightfall]]
|specialgallery = elementalist standard eyes}}
'''Elementalist Third Eye''' is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and is also craftable throughout the campaign, except at max armor rating. It is only available from crafters. It does not provide an attribute bonus.
An exception to this is the Third Eye given by [[Professor Yakkington]] in [[Pre-Searing]] which grants a bonus of [[Item's Attribute]] +1. It is also available in Nightfall, but only as starter headgear.
